summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and VerticalCenter in the repository. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack-based walk, indent of four cells per level). rich/align.py constrains Align rendering to the measured maximum width, adds Align.__repr__, and adds the public VerticalCenter class (render with newline-segment padding based on console.size.height, measurement delegated to the wrapped renderable, repr). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in collected render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added entry, keeping the markdown entry. Tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, render, measure for VerticalCenter; repr for Align) and tests/test_tree.py (tree measurement expecting (11, 19)). Nothing was committed. Tests were not run, per instructions; all results are verified by reading only.
